policy: Corpora are never fetched implicitly. An operator supplies an authorized local copy; the importer verifies the pinned identity and emits provenance metadata. Source code is not vendored into SecHelix.

corpora.publisher: NIST / NSA Center for Assured Software

license.note: NIST states Juliet C/C++ 1.3 is not subject to US copyright protection and makes foreign rights available under CC0 1.0. Preserve suite attribution and NIST disclaimer metadata.
Benchmark test sources identify the project as GPL v2. Preserve the repository license, copyright notices, and attribution; do not relicense imported source.
